_comment: Bundled-library license facts where Arch's package-level metadata is non-SPDX, covers other programs of the package, or ships no license file. 'license' replaces the package expression for the bundled library; 'texts' (repo paths, fetched from the upstream tag) are shipped in addition to the package's own license directory.

e2fsprogs.note: only libcom_err.so.2 (lib/et) is bundled; MIT-style per its source headers (NOTICE)

lz4.note: liblz4 (lib/LICENSE); the GPL-2.0-or-later in Arch metadata covers the lz4 CLI

keyutils.note: libkeyutils; GPL-2.0-or-later covers the keyctl tools
